title: 4,200 sq.ft Showroom · One World Metro, Thaltej
address: One World Metro, Thaltej Shilaj Road, Thaltej, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380059
description: Ground floor showroom in One World Metro, Thaltej, with 4,200 sq.ft super built up and 2,500 sq.ft carpet and a 30 ft frontage.

Set in a G+7 building with 1 lifts and 8 units per floor, around 5 to 10 years old. Rent is ₹110 per sq.ft on super built up or ₹185 per sq.ft on carpet. Well suited to Furniture, Clothing, Garments, Designer, Salon, Jewellery, Bank, Cafe and Restaurant.
